sectors.name: Sheltered Kelp
sectors.description: A broad kelp basin, shallow shelves and quiet island pockets.
sectors.flowLabel: Gentle main flow · quiet lee pockets

sectors.name: South Reef
sectors.description: Braided island channels, a fast throat and back-eddies close to still water.

sectors.name: Outer Ledge
sectors.description: Exposed deep water meets a long reef shoulder, bowls and drying rock.
sectors.flowLabel: Oblique flow · shelf boundary · sheltered bowl

sectors.name: Stormbreak Channel
sectors.description: A long tidal channel between steep islands. Shelves offer respite from the central race.
sectors.flowLabel: Strong variable races · gusty wind · uncharted crowns

sectors.name: Gale Sound
sectors.description: Crosswind and braided passages separate four islands; the eastern race reverses sharply.
sectors.flowLabel: Strong variable races · gusty wind · uncharted crowns

sectors.name: Broken Cape
sectors.description: An exposed cape with a broken transverse reef. Look for safe tide windows around the shoulder.
sectors.flowLabel: Strong variable races · gusty wind · uncharted crowns

sectors.name: Blackwater Reach
sectors.description: Deep fast water wraps around an uncharted central ridge. Productive pockets lie outside the race.
sectors.flowLabel: Extreme tidal races · shifting gusts · dense uncharted crowns

sectors.name: Wreck Teeth
sectors.description: Narrow slots between long rock teeth funnel powerful currents and gusts. Few rivals attempt them.
sectors.flowLabel: Extreme tidal races · shifting gusts · dense uncharted crowns

sectors.name: Last Light Bank
sectors.description: A remote bank faces open swell and shifting shelf flow. Rich ground comes with the longest return passage.
sectors.flowLabel: Extreme tidal races · shifting gusts · dense uncharted crowns

sectors.name: Knifepoint Race
sectors.description: A wall of current follows the shore. The long headland sheds a different working eddy on flood and ebb. Read the kelp before committing.
sectors.flowLabel: Shoreline current wall · reversing headland eddies · deep shelter

sectors.name: Boulder Garden
sectors.description: Enter the boulder basin on high water, wait for exposed rocks to shelter the pick, then wait for water to leave. Even jets cannot escape at low tide.
sectors.flowLabel: Drying sill · high-water entry · low-water shelter · rising-water exit

sectors.name: Needle Sluice
sectors.description: A shallow gate admits waterjets only near high tide. Cross the race, sound the sill and plan the next tide before working the rich basin.
sectors.flowLabel: Drying sill · high-water entry · low-water shelter · rising-water exit

sectors.name: Seventy Foot Shelf
sectors.description: The best product lies at 18–21 metres. Long passages reward speed; repeated deep work rewards nitrox and disciplined surface intervals.
sectors.flowLabel: Shoreline current wall · reversing headland eddies · deep shelter

sectors.name: Devil’s Elbow
sectors.description: A remote deep headland behind a tidal conveyor. The lee swaps sides with the current; speed and highly trained divers matter.
sectors.flowLabel: Shoreline current wall · reversing headland eddies · deep shelter

sectors.name: The Locked Vault
sectors.description: Jet access, a distant harbour, deep premium picking and a drying gate. Enter high, fish low, leave on the rise. Night gear and rested crew may be essential.
sectors.flowLabel: Drying sill · high-water entry · low-water shelter · rising-water exit
